description: Recent per-app metrics from its server: container state (running/restarting/exited), restart count, CPU percent, memory bytes against its limit, and volume bytes — minute-bucketed over the last 24 hours. The state "unknown" means the agent has not reported recently; unknown is never "healthy". Numbers only — the report the agent sends cannot carry configuration or secrets. Use it to see whether an app is actually alive and what it costs.

minutes.description: How far back the series goes (5-1440, default 120).

name: impreza_app_metrics
title: Read app metrics
